reviews.author: Jessica Malish
reviews.text: Best prices around! Kind, timely and courteous- you couldn’t ask for a better team to trim your trees or for a tree removal. They removed a massive pine tree from our front yard and trimmed the huge old oak in our back to perfection. We will be calling them for all our future tree trimming and removal needs. Thanks guys for all your hard work!

about.title: Serving our Houston community since 2010
text: Better View Tree Service has been committed to serving our community in Houston and the surrounding area since 2010.
We listen to what you need for your trees, then offer you options at a fair price. Our crews follow strict quality control standards on every job.
We aim to be responsive, professional and good at our craft, and we are not happy unless you are. Taking a tree out can give you and your family an added sense of safety and a better view.
